test_title: PYST 12: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment in the following sentence.

Raymond has opted __the study of religion__ as his major subject in graduation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Theology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Theology"** refers to the study of the nature of God and religious belief. (धर्मशास्त्र)

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to pursue theology to better understand his faith and religious practices.
 
 
 
• **"Religion" **is a particular system of faith and worship. (धर्म)
 
 
• **Example:** Christianity, Islam, and Hinduism are some of the major religions in the world.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Theology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Psephology** (निर्वाचन शास्त्र): The study of elections and voting.

 
 
• **Example:** His expertise in psephology makes him a valuable political analyst.
 
 
 
• **Philology** (भाषाशास्त्र): The study of language in written historical sources.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a degree in philology, specializing in ancient Greek texts.
 
 
 
• **Psychology** (मनोविज्ञान): The scientific study of the human mind and its functions.
 
 
• **Example:** He is studying psychology to understand human behavior better.
